name: Eldoret
registryAssessment: The official State Department for Lands registry directory identifies Uasin Gishu / Eldoret Ardhi House and land registration, administration, valuation, survey and mapping functions. This establishes a local registry custodian and procedure context, but no anonymous public cadastral parcel response with safe native ID and geometry was verified; registryFound therefore remains null.

queries.query: Eldoret Kenya official cadastral parcel GIS map county land registry
queries.result: Found the official City of Eldoret service portal, official State Department for Lands registry directory listing Eldoret Ardhi House, eProcedures contact details, and Ardhisasa. Also found a public ArcGIS service named Parcels_v, but its metadata extent is Nairobi rather than Eldoret and it was excluded as a false positive. Eldoret-specific public ArcGIS services found were land-use/land-cover and city-boundary/roads layers, not cadastral parcels.

queries.query: Eldoret Kenya ramani ya ardhi kadastri viwanja huduma rasmi
queries.result: Search returned the Kenya Lands Department Swahili service charter and the same official national land-service ecosystem. The Swahili materials describe land registration, survey/mapping and plot services, but no public Eldoret parcel viewer or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

officialSources.role: Kenya State Department for Lands official registry directory
officialSources.observation: Lists Uasin Gishu / Eldoret Ardhi House, Oloo Street, Eldoret, with land registration, administration, valuation, survey and mapping functions. It is a custodian/procedure listing, not an open parcel-vector API.

officialSources.role: Official City of Eldoret service portal
officialSources.observation: Provides official city land-rates/property-charge and property-valuation pathways, but no public cadastral map or parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the fetched page.
Public Angular application shell loaded anonymously. No login was attempted and no safe anonymous parcel query/schema/geometry response was obtained.

officialSources.role: Public ArcGIS service discovered for Eldoret
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 metadata identifies polygon layer Land Use 2020 in Web Mercator; it is land-use/land-cover, not cadastral parcel geometry, so it was not retained as a parcel sample.

officialSources.role: Public ArcGIS service discovered for Eldoret
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 metadata identifies EldoretCityBoundary and Roads_prj layers in Web Mercator; no parcel layer is present.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The generic Parcels_v candidate was rejected because its metadata full extent is Nairobi. Eldoret-specific public layers are land use and boundary/roads only. The WUP point was preserved exactly and was not shifted to force a hit; no exact-point parcel test was claimed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Eldoret city services, Uasin Gishu/Eldoret Ardhi House registry functions, Kenya national land-service application, and Eldoret-specific public ArcGIS thematic/boundary layers.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official custodian and service existence plus non-cadastral Eldoret thematic/boundary metadata were verified; citywide parcel-vector access, native parcel identity, parcel schema, parcel CRS response, and exact-point containment remain unverified.
